Process: Baker's yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae) grown in a fed-batch bioreactor. Biomass concentration x1 and substrate (glucose) concentration x2 are measured every hour, in g/L. The operator sets the dilution rate u1 (1/h) and the substrate concentration in the feed u2 (g/L), both held constant between switches. Three experiments of 20 h with different starting biomass and input profiles. Measurement error is about 5% of the reading plus 0.01 g/L. The growth kinetics are unknown: find the rate law that explains the data.

Fitted candidates (all on the same data, 126 readings):

Candidate C8 (asprey_2000_contois_kinetics eq 18, rate law r = theta1*x2/(theta2*x1 + x2)):
asprey_2000_monod_kinetics + asprey_2000_contois_kinetics eq 18: chi2 955.9 vs limit 148.8 (p = 0.000) (LACK OF FIT); AIC 963.9; probability 0.000
   theta1   0.3591  95% CI [0.3495, 0.3686]  t 37.69
   theta2   0.01681  95% CI [0.01588, 0.01774]  t 18.04
   theta3   0.6058  95% CI [0.5873, 0.6243]  t 32.75
   theta4   0.08551  95% CI [0.07845, 0.09256]  t 12.12
   misfit mostly in: E3:x2 (chi2 411 over 21 readings, model under-predicts on average, worst at t=20 h); E2:x2 (chi2 244 over 21 readings, model under-predicts on average, worst at t=17 h); E1:x2 (chi2 194 over 21 readings, model over-predicts on average, worst at t=4 h)

Candidate C9 (asprey_2000_monod_kinetics eq 17, rate law r = theta1*x2/(theta2 + x2)):
asprey_2000_monod_kinetics + asprey_2000_monod_kinetics eq 17: chi2 961.4 vs limit 148.8 (p = 0.000) (LACK OF FIT); AIC 969.4; probability 0.000
   theta1   0.3354  95% CI [0.3279, 0.3428]  t 45.24
   theta2   0.08441  95% CI [0.07979, 0.08902]  t 18.29
   theta3   0.5422  95% CI [0.5284, 0.5561]  t 39.07
   theta4   0.07259  95% CI [0.06706, 0.07812]  t 13.13
   misfit mostly in: E3:x2 (chi2 366 over 21 readings, model under-predicts on average, worst at t=20 h); E2:x2 (chi2 250 over 21 readings, model under-predicts on average, worst at t=7 h); E1:x2 (chi2 110 over 21 readings, model over-predicts on average, worst at t=4 h)

Candidate C27 (muloiwa_2020_free_laws eq 6, rate law r = mumax*x2/(Ks + x2 + x2**2/Ki)):
asprey_2000_monod_kinetics + muloiwa_2020_free_laws eq 6: chi2 106.3 vs limit 147.7 (p = 0.828) (fits within the noise); AIC 116.3; probability 1.000
   Ki       4.162  95% CI [3.485, 4.839]  t 6.15
   Ks       0.3129  95% CI [0.2762, 0.3496]  t 8.52
   mumax    0.5031  95% CI [0.4731, 0.533]  t 16.79
   theta3   0.557  95% CI [0.5355, 0.5786]  t 25.83
   theta4   0.05379  95% CI [0.04604, 0.06154]  t 6.94
   ! Ki and Ks correlated (-0.954): this data separates them only poorly (a caveat; their t-values above say whether each is still estimated precisely)
   ! only 2 of 4 starting points reached this fit: other starts stopped at worse local optima

Round 1 of 3. Decide. If you accept, 'chosen' is the candidate label, e.g. C8.

answer.feedback: C27 fits within the noise and all five parameters are estimated precisely (t-values above 1). Its Akaike weight is 1.000, so it is strongly preferred among these candidates. Ki and Ks are strongly correlated, which is a caveat and motivates a more informative experiment, but does not disqualify this fit.
answer.reasoning: C8 and C9 show severe lack of fit, while C27 has chi2 106.3 below the 95% limit of 147.7. Although only two of four starting points reached this fit, the reported solution meets the acceptance criteria.
